project_type: MERN stack (MongoDB + Express + React/Vite + Node.js) full-stack application
build_system: npm workspaces not used - separate package.json in /server and /client; backend runs with node/nodemon, frontend with Vite
test_framework: No test framework specified - manual testing via API calls and browser
build_command: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
test_command: Manual: start MongoDB, seed DB (node server/utils/seed.js), start backend (cd server && npm run dev), start frontend (cd client && npm run dev), test in browser
verification_instructions: 1. Ensure MongoDB is running locally or set MONGO_URI in .env. 2. Install dependencies for both server and client. 3. Run seed script to populate DB. 4. Start backend server (should listen on port from .env, default 5000). 5. Start frontend dev server (should listen on port from .env, default 5173). 6. Open browser to frontend URL. 7. Test: register user, login, create post, vote, view roadmap, login as admin, change post status. 8. Verify JWT persistence across page refreshes.
environment_constraints: MongoDB must be running (local or Atlas). Backend and frontend must run on different ports. JWT_SECRET must be set in server/.env. VITE_API_URL must point to backend in client/.env.
contribution_requirements: Code must be beginner-readable with comments on non-obvious logic. No features beyond spec (no real-time, image uploads, emails). Use consistent error format { success: false, message, errors? }. HTTP status codes must be correct (401 for auth failures, 403 for forbidden, 404 for not found, 400 for validation, 500 for server errors).
key_patterns: JWT stored in localStorage, attached via Axios interceptor. Optimistic UI for voting with rollback on failure. Vote toggle pattern: check if vote exists, if yes delete it and $inc voteCount by -1, if no create it and $inc by 1, catch duplicate key error. hasVoted field computed in GET /api/posts by checking Vote collection if user authenticated. Protected routes use AuthContext. Admin routes check role === 'admin'. Centralized error handler middleware catches all errors and formats response.
directory_structure: /server contains backend (config/, models/, controllers/, routes/, middleware/, utils/, server.js). /client contains React app (src/components/, src/pages/, src/context/, src/api/, src/hooks/, src/App.jsx, src/main.jsx). Root contains README.md. Each side has its own package.json and .env.example.
